title: Hollow Men Gather
sideASummary: Infection deck back. Red biohazard on a dark field. No printed text.
sideBSummary: HOLLOW MEN GATHER, code P2-21b. Drawing this card is not an Infection card draw. Draw the next Infection card and add a Hollow Men figure to it instead of infecting it. If you draw another Hollow Men Gather card, keep drawing. Add only 1 figure to the first city you reveal.

rules: Infection-deck card. Drawing it does not count as an Infection card draw.
Draw the next Infection card and add a Hollow Men figure to that city instead of infecting it.
If the next card is another Hollow Men Gather card, keep drawing.
Add only 1 figure, and add it to the first city revealed.
No city name, no upgrade panel, and no improvement slot.
notes: Indexes 22, 23, and 24 are further copies. All four faces print P2-21b.
The recon report puts all 4 into the Infection discard pile when the package is opened.
Rule S and Rule T, in this package, are the full procedure: skip supply and plague, cap a city at 3 figures, and ignore a Gather card drawn in epidemic step 2.
